description: ~/.claude/shelf/herdr-state/<sid>.json: written by x-mod-stash's hooks/session-record.ts, read by herdr; any harness that writes this shape draws in herdr (FRM-618 slice D, W27, W42)

at.description: when the file was written, ms

pid.description: the thread's process; a pid no longer live reads idle from `at`

since.description: when `state` began, ms: a turn's end for waiting or idle after a turn

state.description: working: a turn runs; waiting: no turn, a background watch or agent alive or the last reply's 🔭 line names a wait; idle: neither

wait.description: the last reply's 🔭 line, else its background tasks, in fleet names

title: a thread's state file on the shelf
